name: io.github.phwizard/mcp-agrus-ai
title: Agrus.ai — Enterprise AI Agency
description: Public MCP server for Agrus.ai, an AI consulting agency for regulated industries (US + Canada). Tools let AI agents list the agency's services, query its compliance position on HIPAA / SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / EU AI Act / NAIC / ABA / AML, scope a Discovery Sprint PoC, request a ballpark quote, and formally request a proposal that creates a tracked CRM lead.
